questions.question: What does chapter 19 describe (a dark account)?
options: A joyful harvest festival held each year at Shiloh
The crowning of one of the judges as king over Israel
The horrific abuse of a Levite's concubine at Gibeah
A royal wedding feast in the land of Benjamin
questions.answer: The horrific abuse of a Levite's concubine at Gibeah

questions.question: What did the Levite do to call all Israel to action?
options: Cut his concubine into twelve pieces and sent them through Israel
Blew a trumpet through the land to summon the fighting men
Prayed publicly and at length for the LORD to send help
Wrote letters of urgent appeal to each one of the tribes
questions.answer: Cut his concubine into twelve pieces and sent them through Israel

questions.question: This account again shows the lawlessness of a time with no king in Israel.
The wicked men of _____ abused the Levite's concubine through the night.
The Levite cut his concubine into _____ pieces and sent them throughout Israel.
